title: The best bike tour ever!
text: Our guide, Thomas, was beyond amazing! The tour was our last before the end of our trip and it was simply the best finish ever! Whether it’s the beginning or end of your vacation, find a way to fit this in - you won’t be disappointed! Awesome service and a great tour of the city with a knowledgeable guide! Highly recommend!!!!
author: 727karolinar

title: Thank you Karolina!!
text: My girlfriend and I we enjoyed a lot the experience :) the anecdotes of Karolina regarding Barcelona are fabulous! Thanks to you we could really appreciate the city even after the tour!!!
author: K2322YBenzod
